_: The inputs a VALUE is rebuilt from at each of this run's origins, committed beside the driver panel under [R-FCAL-01 AMENDED]. A driver panel is not a record a value can be rebuilt from, and the difference is invisible until something tries.
company: Talaat Mostafa Group Holding Company "TMG Holding" S.A.E
units: as printed in the filings — units, not thousands or millions
point_in_time: every origin is carried AS FIRST REPORTED, from its own filing's own current-year column; where a later filing restates a figure the difference is recorded beside it and never substituted.
route: text layer where the page carries one and OCR off the rendered pixels at 300 dpi where it does not — this issuer's balance-sheet continuation pages carry no text layer in several years. ARITHMETIC IS THE ARBITER: every page was footed against its own printed totals before any figure from it was kept, and the two OCR splits that occurred (a thousands group broken by a space in FY2024) were caught by that footing rather than by inspection.

origins_not_held.FY2011 … FY2019: NO ANNUAL FILING IN THIS RUN'S OWN ARCHIVE. The 25 documents held are the FY2020–FY2025 annuals and interim statements from 2020 onward, plus one Arabic interim from 2016. RECORDED AS MISSING WITH ITS REASON rather than reconstructed from the driver panel or from a later filing's comparative column [SIGCM clause 8]: a figure carried back from a restated comparative is fabricated in vintage, plausible on the page and invisible in the pooled error afterwards.

prior_year_anchor._: FY2017, FY2018 and FY2019 are NOT origins of this run and adding them tests nothing new: this run's origins are FY2020-FY2025 and stay exactly that. They are carried because a trailing window reaches back past the first origin — a capital-spending intensity is taken over the three fiscal years to an origin, so FY2020 reads FY2018, FY2019 and FY2020, and the identity capex = dPPE + D&A needs the property base at two dates, so FY2018's capex reads FY2017. Recording any of them inside `origins` would misstate what this run tested. FY2017 is reached ONLY by that identity and sits in no window.
prior_year_anchor.source_class: EVERY FIGURE HERE COMES FROM THE COMPANY'S OWN EARNINGS RELEASES RATHER THAN FROM AUDITED STATEMENTS, under [R-SIGCM-03], and the principal was told so in the turn that used it. The statement was tried first: this run's own archive holds no annual filing before FY2020 and its `origins_not_held` field says so, and the company's investor-relations index — re-probed 08-09-2026, apex host answering, 385 documents listed — carries the FY2018 and FY2019 earnings releases and NO audited financial-statement link naming either fiscal year, the statements beginning at 2020. So the fallback is not a workaround for a site that will not answer; the statement is not on the shelf at all. WHERE A LATER AUDITED DOCUMENT HAPPENS TO CARRY THE SAME FIGURE IT IS RECORDED AS A CROSS-CHECK AND NEVER SUBSTITUTED, because point-in-time discipline takes each year as first reported.
prior_year_anchor.basis: THE RELEASE'S BALANCE-SHEET TAXONOMY WAS TESTED AGAINST THE AUDITED STATEMENT'S RATHER THAN ASSUMED TO MATCH, on the one year where both exist. At FY2020 every audited line this block reads equals its release line exactly — inventory 1,119.4, accounts and notes receivable 31,112.1, development properties 46,202.9, creditors and notes payable 22,363.4, customers' advance payments 37,870.0 — and the working-capital definition this run committed at FY2020 reproduces off the release lines to EGP 0.05mn on 18,200.9, which is the rounding of figures printed to one decimal. THE FIRST RUN OF THAT TEST REPORTED A 53% GAP AND THE GAP WAS THE READER'S: it added the release's 'accrued expenses and other credit balances' on top of notes payable, and the audited 'creditors and notes payable' line is the release's notes-payable line alone. The discrepancy was exactly that row. There is no basis break; there was a wrong mapping, and it was measured rather than argued [L-355].
